title: Sweep remaining IID-embedding callers after AddrForKey migration (i72x.2 follow-up)
description: Follow-up to i72x.2 (commit 5c9f7ef657), which migrated rust/lichen-core ygg_addr_from_pubkey to upstream AddrForKey and fixed the lichen-gateway callers (capability_announcements pubkey_to_iid, trust.rs + resources.rs native-addr vectors). Remaining Rust production-code callers still assume the routable address's lower 64 bits == the SHA-512 IID, which is now FALSE: (1) lichen-link/src/trust.rs:232 verify_ygg_iid_binding asserts ygg_addr[8:16]==iid — semantically invalid post-migration, needs a design decision (remove the function, or re-scope to link-local); (2) lichen-node/src/routing/neighbor.rs:179 remove_with_iid compares neighbor.addr[8..]==signer_iid; (3) lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs:214 matches SRH destination by destination[8..]==local_rpl_addr[8..] where local_rpl_addr is now AddrForKey (lower bits no longer the IID); (4) lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/dodag.rs:1655 builds an address by copying an IID into addr[8..]. Each needs review: derive IID via iid_from_pubkey_bytes directly, or compare full AddrForKey. NOT done in i72x.2 to stay in timebox. Verify cargo test -p lichen-link -p lichen-node green after.
